title: Simplicity of the Nontrivial Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function
exact_target: Does the zeta function cross zero with multiplicity one at every nontrivial zero, wherever that zero lies in the critical strip?

sources.citation: H. M. Bui and D. R. Heath-Brown, "On simple zeros of the Riemann zeta-function," Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society 45(5) (2013), 953-961.
